prompt:
## Objective
Add a capture-queue health check to `memento health`: report queue backlog size and oldest-entry age against thresholds (WARN/FAIL). Today health has zero references to queue paths, so the real backlog incident would recur invisibly.

## Design summary
Reuse the existing queue-path resolution from memento/pi_bridge.py (read it for the helper; do not re-derive the paths - that logic is already triplicated per audit M9, do not add a fourth copy). Thresholds are config-overridable with documented conservative defaults; state the chosen defaults in the delivery summary for review. ~50 lines of check code expected.

## File scope
Include: memento/health.py, new/updated tests under tests/.
Read-only reference: memento/pi_bridge.py (queue path resolution).
Exclude: the queue lock itself (MEM-123, HITL), pi_bridge edits, everything else.

## Constraints
No git push or PR creation - local branch/diff only. Use the repo venv: .venv/bin/python for every command. Work test-first: failing test with a seeded backlogged queue before the check. If an acceptance criterion is ambiguous, pause and ask - do not invent behavior.

## Verification
From the repo root:
1. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -k 'queue and health or queue_health' (the new tests, green) and the configured targeted-tests gate
2. .venv/bin/python -m ruff check .
3. .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check .
4. .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q memento hooks scripts
dependencies: memento/health.py, memento/pi_bridge.py present at pinned base (probed)

success_criteria: new backlogged-queue test exists and passes

output_expectations.summary: The new health check, chosen threshold defaults, and config override keys.
output_expectations.next_step: ready-for-review handoff; human reviews and opens the PR

allow: Edit memento/health.py and add/update tests under tests/
Run the configured gates and slice verification commands
Create/commit on a local work branch (vic/mem-124-*)
ask: Any edit outside the include scope
New config keys beyond the two thresholds
deny: git push, PR creation, or any remote write
Editing pi_bridge.py or the queue lock (MEM-123 territory)
Re-deriving queue paths instead of reusing the existing resolution
